name: Product card
summary: A card for a digital product or plan add-on: a cover drawn from the tokens, name, one-line description, rating, price with the old price struck out, an Add button and a save toggle.
use: in a store or marketplace grid
a11y: Add and save are toggle buttons with aria-pressed; the rating and the old price are read as words ("Rated 4.6 out of 5", "was $32"), and the cover is decorative.
